seo.title: Services | Aesthetic Dental & Skin Clinic, Nagpur
seo.description: Our dental services are designed to maintain oral health, restore function and enhance smile aesthetics.

props.heading: Dental Treatment
props.body: Our dental services are designed to maintain oral health, restore function and enhance smile aesthetics. From preventive care and restorative procedures to cosmetic dentistry and dental implants, every treatment plan is tailored to the patient's individual needs, oral condition and long-term treatment goals.
props.label: Services

items.title: Teeth Cleaning & Polishing
items.desc: Professional teeth cleaning and polishing help remove plaque, tartar and surface stains that cannot be eliminated through regular brushing alone. This treatment is suitable for individuals seeking better oral hygiene, fresher breath and healthier gums. Regular cleaning helps reduce the risk of gum disease and contributes to a cleaner, brighter smile.

items.title: Tooth-Coloured Fillings
items.desc: Tooth-coloured fillings are used to restore teeth affected by decay, minor fractures or wear while maintaining a natural appearance. They blend closely with the surrounding tooth structure and help restore strength and function. The result is a durable and aesthetically pleasing restoration.

items.title: Root Canal Treatment
items.desc: Root canal treatment is recommended when the dental pulp becomes infected or inflamed due to deep decay or injury. The procedure helps preserve the natural tooth, relieve discomfort and prevent further infection. Following treatment, the tooth can continue functioning normally with appropriate restoration.

items.title: Crowns & Bridges
items.desc: Crowns and bridges are restorative solutions used to repair damaged teeth or replace missing teeth. Crowns strengthen weakened teeth, while bridges help restore gaps in the smile. These restorations improve appearance, chewing efficiency and overall oral function.

items.title: Smile Designing
items.desc: Smile designing combines cosmetic dental procedures to enhance the appearance of teeth, gums and overall smile aesthetics. It may benefit individuals with discoloured, uneven, worn or misaligned teeth. The goal is to create a balanced, natural-looking and confident smile.

items.title: Dental Implants
items.desc: Dental implants provide a long-term solution for replacing missing teeth. They function as artificial tooth roots that support replacement teeth while helping preserve jawbone health. Dental implants restore appearance, stability and chewing ability, offering results that closely resemble natural teeth.

items.title: Tooth Extractions
items.desc: Tooth extraction may be required when a tooth is severely damaged, infected or cannot be preserved through other treatments. The procedure is performed carefully with a focus on patient comfort. Proper post-treatment care promotes healing and supports future restorative options when needed.

items.title: Preventive Dental Checkups
items.desc: Regular dental checkups help detect oral health concerns at an early stage before they become more complex. Examinations include assessment of teeth, gums and overall oral health. Preventive care supports long-term oral wellness and helps maintain a healthy smile.

items.title: Gum Health Assessment
items.desc: A gum health assessment evaluates the condition of the gums and supporting structures around the teeth. It helps identify signs of gum inflammation, bleeding or periodontal disease. Early diagnosis allows timely intervention and supports long-term oral health.

props.heading: Skin Treatment
props.body: We provide personalized skin treatments for acne, pigmentation, uneven skin tone, acne scars and age-related skin concerns. Following a detailed skin assessment, treatment plans are customized to improve skin health, texture, clarity and overall appearance while maintaining a natural and balanced look.
props.label: Services

items.title: Acne Treatment
items.desc: Acne treatment is customized according to the severity and type of acne affecting the skin. It aims to reduce active breakouts, control inflammation and minimize future flare-ups. With appropriate management, patients can achieve healthier and clearer-looking skin.

items.title: Acne Scar Management
items.desc: Acne scar management focuses on improving the appearance of scars left behind after acne. Treatment plans may include procedures designed to enhance skin texture and stimulate collagen remodeling. The goal is smoother, more even-looking skin over time.

items.title: Hydrafacial Treatment
items.desc: HydraFacial is a professional skin treatment designed to cleanse, exfoliate, extract impurities and hydrate the skin. The treatment is customized according to individual skin concerns and is commonly chosen by patients seeking healthier-looking, refreshed and hydrated skin.

items.title: Pigmentation Treatment
items.desc: Pigmentation treatments address concerns such as uneven skin tone, dark patches and post-inflammatory pigmentation. Treatment selection depends on the underlying cause and skin type. The objective is to achieve a more uniform and brighter complexion.

items.title: Chemical Peels
items.desc: Chemical peels use carefully selected solutions to exfoliate damaged skin layers and promote skin renewal. They may benefit patients with acne, pigmentation, dullness and uneven texture. The skin often appears fresher, smoother and more radiant following treatment.

items.title: Anti-Aging Procedures
items.desc: Anti-aging treatments are designed to address concerns such as fine lines, wrinkles, skin laxity and loss of skin vitality. Treatment plans focus on improving skin quality and supporting a refreshed, youthful appearance while maintaining natural facial harmony.

items.title: Medi Facials
items.desc: Medi facials are professional skin treatments tailored to individual skin concerns and goals. They help cleanse, hydrate and rejuvenate the skin while supporting overall skin health. Patients often notice improved skin texture and radiance.

items.title: Mole Removal
items.desc: Mole removal is performed for selected cosmetic or medical concerns following clinical assessment. The procedure aims to remove unwanted moles safely while minimizing skin disruption. Appropriate aftercare supports healing and optimal cosmetic outcomes.

items.title: Wart Removal
items.desc: Wart removal treatments target unwanted skin growths caused by viral infection. Treatment selection depends on the location, size and characteristics of the wart. The goal is to achieve smoother skin and reduce the risk of recurrence.

items.title: Body Polishing
items.desc: Body polishing is an exfoliating treatment designed to remove dead skin cells and improve skin smoothness. It helps enhance skin texture, softness and overall appearance. The treatment leaves the skin feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.

items.title: Skin Rejuvenation Treatments
items.desc: Skin rejuvenation treatments focus on improving skin quality, texture and overall appearance. They may help address dullness, uneven tone and early signs of aging. The result is healthier-looking, refreshed and more radiant skin.

props.heading: Hair Treatment
props.body: Our hair treatment services focus on identifying the underlying causes of hair fall and scalp concerns through detailed clinical evaluation and trichoscopy. Treatment plans are designed to support scalp health, reduce hair loss and promote healthier hair growth using evidence-based approaches.
props.label: Services

items.title: Hair Fall Treatment
items.desc: Hair fall treatment begins with identifying the underlying cause of hair loss through clinical evaluation. Treatment plans are customized according to the patient's condition and may focus on reducing hair shedding, improving scalp health and supporting healthier hair growth.

items.title: Trichoscopy
items.desc: Trichoscopy is a non-invasive diagnostic procedure used to examine the scalp and hair follicles in detail. It helps identify hair loss patterns, scalp disorders and follicular health, allowing more accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.

items.title: Hair Regrowth Consultation
items.desc: Hair regrowth consultations involve comprehensive assessment of hair concerns, scalp health and contributing factors. Based on clinical findings, personalized recommendations are provided to support hair preservation and regrowth goals.

items.title: Dandruff Management
items.desc: Dandruff management focuses on controlling scalp flaking, itching and irritation. Treatment recommendations are tailored according to scalp condition and severity. The goal is to improve scalp comfort and maintain a healthier scalp environment.

items.title: Male Pattern Hair Loss Management
items.desc: Male pattern hair loss management addresses progressive hair thinning commonly seen in men. Early evaluation and treatment may help slow hair loss, preserve existing hair and support improved hair density.

items.title: Female Pattern Hair Loss Management
items.desc: Female pattern hair loss management focuses on identifying the causes of hair thinning and developing individualized treatment strategies. The aim is to support healthier hair growth and improve overall hair volume and appearance.

items.title: PRP Therapy
items.desc: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy uses growth factors derived from the patient's own blood to support hair follicle stimulation. It is commonly used for individuals experiencing hair thinning and aims to improve hair quality and density over time.

items.title: GFC Therapy
items.desc: Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) therapy utilizes concentrated growth factors to support scalp health and hair follicle activity. It is designed to help reduce hair fall and encourage healthier hair growth in suitable candidates.

props.heading: Laser Treatments
props.body: Advanced laser procedures are available for hair reduction, pigmentation concerns, skin rejuvenation and overall skin enhancement. Treatment recommendations are based on individual skin type, clinical assessment and desired treatment outcomes to ensure safe and effective results.
props.label: Services

items.title: Laser Hair Reduction
items.desc: Laser hair reduction provides long-term reduction of unwanted hair by targeting hair follicles while preserving surrounding skin. It is suitable for various body areas and helps achieve smoother skin with reduced hair growth over multiple sessions.

items.title: Laser Toning
items.desc: Laser toning is used to improve skin clarity, pigmentation concerns and overall skin tone. The treatment stimulates skin renewal processes and may help create a brighter, more even complexion.

items.title: Pigmentation Laser Treatments
items.desc: Pigmentation laser treatments target unwanted pigmentation and uneven skin tone using focused laser energy. Treatment plans are customized according to skin type and pigmentation pattern to support a clearer complexion.

items.title: Skin Rejuvenation Laser Treatments
items.desc: Skin rejuvenation laser treatments help improve skin texture, tone and overall quality by stimulating natural skin renewal. They are often selected for patients seeking fresher, healthier-looking skin.

items.title: Acne Scar Laser Treatment
items.desc: Acne scar laser treatment helps improve the appearance of acne scars by supporting collagen remodeling and skin renewal. Treatment outcomes develop gradually as the skin undergoes natural healing processes.

items.title: Carbon Laser Peel
items.desc: Carbon laser peel is a non-invasive procedure designed to exfoliate the skin, reduce excess oil and improve overall skin texture. Patients often notice smoother, brighter and refreshed skin following treatment.

items.title: Photo Rejuvenation
items.desc: Photo rejuvenation addresses concerns such as uneven skin tone, pigmentation and signs of sun damage. The treatment promotes skin renewal and contributes to a clearer and more youthful appearance.

items.title: Uneven Skin Tone Treatment
items.desc: Treatments for uneven skin tone are selected based on the underlying cause and individual skin characteristics. The goal is to improve skin uniformity, brightness and overall complexion.

items.title: Skin Brightening Procedures
items.desc: Skin brightening procedures are designed to enhance skin radiance and improve the appearance of dull or tired-looking skin. Treatment plans focus on promoting healthier, more luminous skin while maintaining natural results.

props.body:
Pigmentation concerns can affect the appearance of the skin and may present as dark patches, uneven skin tone, acne marks or localized discoloration. props.heading: What is Skin Pigmentation?
props.body:
Pigmentation refers to changes in skin color caused by increased melanin production in certain areas of the skin. It may appear as brown patches, dark spots, post-acne marks or uneven skin tone.

The type and depth of pigmentation influence treatment planning and expected outcomes.

props.heading: Common Pigmentation Concerns

props.heading: Causes of Pigmentation

Genetic factors

Understanding the cause is important for selecting the most suitable treatment plan.

props.heading: Types of Pigmentation
props.body:
Different forms of pigmentation may require different treatment approaches. Common pigmentation concerns include:

MELASMA
Melasma commonly appears as brown or grayish patches on the cheeks, forehead, nose and upper lip. Hormonal influences, sun exposure and genetic factors may contribute to its development.

POST-INFLAMMATORY HYPERPIGMENTATION (PIH)
These are dark marks that may develop after acne, skin irritation, injury or inflammation. They are commonly seen following acne breakouts.

SUN-INDUCED PIGMENTATION
Prolonged exposure to ultraviolet (UV) radiation may lead to the development of dark spots and uneven skin tone over time.

FRECKLES
Freckles are small pigmented spots that often become more noticeable with sun exposure. They may occur in individuals with a genetic tendency.

AGE SPOTS
Also known as solar lentigines, these pigmented spots commonly appear with increasing age and cumulative sun exposure.

UNEVEN SKIN TONE
Some individuals experience generalized pigmentation resulting in an uneven complexion rather than distinct dark patches.

A detailed skin assessment helps determine the type of pigmentation and the most appropriate treatment approach.

Chemical peels are among the most widely used aesthetic skin treatments for improving skin texture, skin tone, pigmentation, acne, acne marks and early signs of aging. At Aesthetic Dental & Skin Clinic, Nagpur, chemical peel treatments are customized according to skin type, skin sensitivity, pigmentation depth, acne severity and treatment goals.

props.heading: What is a Chemical Peel?
props.body:
A chemical peel is a skin resurfacing procedure that uses specially formulated acids to remove damaged outer layers of skin and stimulate skin renewal.

As older skin cells are shed, healthier new skin cells emerge, resulting in smoother, brighter and more even-looking skin.

Chemical peels can be performed at different depths depending on the concern being treated.

props.heading: Skin Concerns That May Benefit from Chemical Peels

Enlarged pores
Rough skin texture
Early signs of skin aging

Suitability is determined after clinical evaluation.

props.heading: How Does a Chemical Peel Work?
props.body:
The peel solution:
• Exfoliates damaged skin cells
• Promotes cellular turnover
• Improves skin texture
• Helps reduce pigmentation
• Supports acne management
• Stimulates collagen remodeling in selected cases

The depth of penetration determines the strength and effect of the peel.

Occasional flaking

Combination Peels

Deep peels penetrate into deeper layers of the skin.

Deep peels require careful patient selection and are performed less frequently than superficial peels.

Professional teeth cleaning, also known as dental scaling and polishing, is an important preventive dental procedure that helps remove plaque, tartar (calculus) and surface stains from teeth. Even with regular brushing and flossing, deposits can accumulate in areas that are difficult to clean at home. Professional cleaning supports healthy gums, fresher breath and improved oral hygiene.

At Aesthetic Dental and Skin Clinic, Nagpur, teeth cleaning and polishing are performed after a clinical examination to help maintain oral health and reduce the risk of gum-related problems.

props.heading: What is Dental Scaling?

props.heading: Why is Professional Teeth Cleaning Important?
props.body:
Professional teeth cleaning may help:
• Remove plaque and tartar deposits

• Reduce bad breath

Have visible tartar deposits

The teeth and gums are evaluated to assess oral health.

Plaque and tartar deposits are carefully removed from the teeth.

3. POLISHING
The teeth are polished to remove minor stains and improve smoothness.

4. ORAL HYGIENE GUIDANCE
Recommendations may be provided regarding brushing, flossing and preventive care.

Treatment procedures may vary according to individual needs.

props.heading: Saving Natural Teeth Through Modern Endodontic Care
props.body: Root canal treatment (RCT) is a dental procedure performed to treat infection or inflammation inside a tooth. The treatment aims to preserve the natural tooth, relieve discomfort and restore normal function. At Aesthetic Dental and Skin Clinic, Nagpur, root canal treatment is planned after careful examination and diagnosis to determine the most appropriate treatment approach.

props.heading: What is Root Canal Treatment?
props.body:
Root canal treatment is performed when the pulp (inner portion) of a tooth becomes infected, inflamed or damaged. The procedure involves cleaning and disinfecting the root canal system and sealing the tooth to help prevent further infection.

Preserving the natural tooth is often preferable to extraction when clinically appropriate.

props.heading: When Might Root Canal Treatment Be Needed?
props.body:
A dentist may recommend root canal treatment in cases involving:
Persistent tooth pain
Sensitivity to hot or cold foods
Deep dental decay
Dental infection
Swelling around a tooth
Tooth trauma or injury
Bad breath

A clinical examination and radiographic assessment help determine the underlying cause.

props.heading: Benefits of Root Canal Treatment
props.body:
Potential benefits may include:
• Relief from dental pain
• Preservation of the natural tooth
• Restoration of normal chewing function
• Prevention of further infection
• Maintenance of smile appearance
• Avoidance of unnecessary extraction where possible

items.title: 2. Local Anesthesia
items.desc: The area is numbed to improve patient comfort during treatment.

items.title: 3. Cleaning of Root Canals
items.desc: Infected or damaged tissue is removed and the canals are cleaned.

items.title: 4. Sealing the Tooth
items.desc: The cleaned canals are sealed to help prevent reinfection

props.heading: Is Root Canal Treatment Painful?
props.body: Modern root canal treatment is generally performed under local anesthesia and is often more comfortable than many patients expect. The treatment aims to relieve pain caused by infection or inflammation.

props.heading: How Long Does Root Canal Treatment Take?
props.body: The number of visits depends on the condition of the tooth, complexity of treatment and clinical findings. Some cases may be completed in fewer visits, while others may require additional appointments.

items.q: Can a tooth be saved after infection?
items.a: Many infected teeth can be preserved through appropriate treatment when diagnosed in time.

items.q: Will I need a crown after root canal treatment?
items.a: In some cases, a crown may be recommended to protect and strengthen the treated tooth.

items.q: Is extraction better than root canal treatment?
items.a: The most appropriate option depends on the condition of the tooth and clinical evaluation. Preserving a natural tooth is often desirable when feasible.

items.q: Can root canal treatment fail?
items.a: As with many medical and dental procedures, outcomes vary. Regular follow-up and oral hygiene are important for long-term success.

props.heading: Personalized Evaluation and Treatment for Hair Loss and Hair Thinning
props.body:
Hair fall is a common concern affecting both men and women. It may occur due to genetics, hormonal changes, nutritional deficiencies, stress, medical conditions or scalp disorders. At Aesthetic Dental and Skin Clinic, Nagpur, hair fall treatment begins with a detailed scalp and hair assessment to identify the underlying cause and develop an individualized treatment plan.

Our goal is to help patients understand the cause of their hair loss and explore suitable treatment options based on clinical findings.

props.heading: What is Hair Fall?
props.body:
Hair fall refers to excessive shedding or thinning of hair beyond the normal hair growth cycle. While some daily hair shedding is normal, persistent or progressive hair loss may require professional evaluation.

Early assessment often allows more effective management of hair and scalp concerns.

props.heading: Common Signs of Hair Loss
props.body:
Patients may notice:
Increased hair shedding
Thinning of hair
Widening of the hair partition
Receding hairline
Reduced hair density
Excess hair on pillows or during washing
Visible scalp through the hair

A detailed examination helps determine the pattern and severity of hair loss.

props.heading: Common Causes of Hair Fall
props.body:
Hair fall may occur due to:

GENETIC FACTORS
Male and female pattern hair loss are among the most common causes of progressive hair thinning.

NUTRITIONAL DEFICIENCIES
Deficiencies of certain nutrients may contribute to hair loss and reduced hair quality.

HORMONAL INFLUENCES
Hormonal changes may affect the hair growth cycle.

STRESS
Physical and emotional stress can contribute to increased hair shedding.

SCALP CONDITIONS
Dandruff, inflammation and scalp disorders may affect hair health.

MEDICAL CONDITIONS
Certain medical conditions and medications may contribute to hair loss.

props.heading: What is Laser Hair Reduction?
props.body:
Laser Hair Reduction is a non-surgical procedure that uses concentrated light energy to target hair follicles beneath the skin.

The laser energy is absorbed by the pigment present within the hair follicle, helping reduce future hair growth while preserving surrounding skin structures. Since hair grows in different cycles, multiple treatment sessions are usually required for optimal results.

Laser Hair Reduction provides long-term hair reduction and may significantly reduce the need for regular shaving, waxing and threading.

props.heading: How Does Laser Hair Reduction Work?
props.body:
The laser emits controlled energy that selectively targets hair follicles during the active growth phase.

Over a series of treatment sessions, the treated follicles become less capable of producing thick, visible hair.

Benefits may include:
• Long-term reduction in unwanted hair
• Smoother skin
• Reduced ingrown hairs
• Reduced dependence on shaving and waxing
• Improved convenience
Individual outcomes vary

items.title: Catagen Phase (Transition Phase)
items.desc: Hair growth slows and the follicle begins transitioning.

items.title: Telogen Phase (Resting Phase)
items.desc: The hair eventually sheds and a new cycle begins.  Since not all hairs are in the same phase at the same time, multiple sessions are required to target hair effectively.

seo.description: Professional teeth cleaning is generally comfortable. Some patients with sensitive gums may experience mild temporary sensitivity.

items.q: Is teeth cleaning painful?
items.a: Professional teeth cleaning is generally comfortable. Some patients with sensitive gums may experience mild temporary sensitivity.

items.q: How often should I get my teeth cleaned?
items.a: Most patients benefit from professional cleaning every 6 months.

items.q: How long does teeth cleaning take?
items.a: Usually 30–60 minutes depending on deposits and staining.

items.q: What are the benefits of professional teeth cleaning?
items.a: Professional cleaning helps remove plaque and tartar deposits, supports gum health and contributes to fresher breath and improved oral hygiene.

items.q: What is a root canal treatment?
items.a: Root canal treatment is performed when the inner portion of a tooth becomes infected or inflamed. The procedure helps preserve the natural tooth and relieve discomfort.

items.q: Is root canal treatment painful?
items.a: Modern root canal treatment is performed under local anesthesia and is generally more comfortable than many patients expect. The procedure aims to relieve pain caused by infection or inflammation.

items.q: Are dental implants painful?
items.a: Dental implant procedures are performed under appropriate anesthesia to ensure patient comfort. Mild soreness after treatment is usually temporary and manageable.

items.q: How long do dental implants last?
items.a: With proper oral hygiene and regular dental checkups, dental implants can provide a long-term solution for replacing missing teeth.

items.q: Can a missing tooth be replaced with a dental implant?
items.a: Dental implants are one option for replacing missing teeth. Suitability depends on oral health, bone support and individual clinical evaluation.

items.q: How long does teeth whitening last?
items.a: Results vary depending on oral hygiene habits, diet and lifestyle factors. Periodic maintenance may be recommended.

items.q: What causes acne?
items.a: Acne can be influenced by excess oil production, hormonal factors, genetics, certain medications and lifestyle-related factors.

items.q: Can acne scars be treated?
items.a: Various treatment options may help improve the appearance of acne scars depending on scar type, skin condition and treatment goals.

items.q: How many sessions are needed for acne treatment?
items.a: The number of sessions varies depending on the severity of acne, skin type and treatment plan. A consultation helps determine the most suitable approach.

items.q: What is a HydraFacial?
items.a: HydraFacial is a professional skin treatment designed to cleanse, exfoliate and hydrate the skin while improving overall skin appearance.

items.q: Can pigmentation be treated?
items.a: Many pigmentation concerns can be improved through appropriate treatments after clinical evaluation. Treatment recommendations depend on the cause and depth of pigmentation.

items.q: Are chemical peels safe?
items.a: When performed after proper assessment and according to skin type, chemical peels are generally safe and can help improve acne, pigmentation and skin texture.

items.q: What is a medi facial?
items.a: A medi facial is a professional skin treatment customized according to individual skin concerns. It focuses on improving skin health, hydration and overall appearance.

items.q: How soon will I see results from skin treatments?
items.a: Results vary depending on the condition being treated and the procedure performed. Some treatments provide visible improvement within days, while others may require multiple sessions.

items.q: Are anti-aging treatments suitable for all ages?
items.a: Treatment recommendations depend on individual skin concerns, skin condition and clinical assessment rather than age alone.

items.q: Why is my hair falling?
items.a: Hair fall can occur due to genetics, nutritional deficiencies, hormonal factors, stress, medical conditions or scalp disorders. A detailed evaluation helps identify contributing factors.

items.q: What is PRP therapy?
items.a: PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy uses growth factors obtained from the patient's own blood to support hair follicle stimulation and healthier hair growth.

items.q: Is PRP therapy suitable for everyone?
items.a: PRP therapy may be considered for suitable candidates after evaluation of hair loss patterns, scalp condition and medical history.

items.q: How long does a PRP session take?
items.a: A PRP session generally takes about 45–60 minutes, including preparation and treatment time.

items.q: What is trichoscopy?
items.a: Trichoscopy is a non-invasive examination of the scalp and hair using magnification. It assists in assessing hair loss patterns and scalp health.

items.q: What is GFC therapy?
items.a: GFC (Growth Factor Concentrate) therapy utilizes concentrated growth factors to support scalp health and promote hair growth in suitable candidates.

items.q: What is the difference between PRP and GFC therapy?
items.a: Both treatments use growth factors, but preparation methods differ. The most appropriate option depends on the patient's condition and treatment goals.

items.q: How many PRP or GFC sessions are needed?
items.a: The number of sessions depends on the degree of hair loss, treatment goals and individual response. Recommendations are provided after clinical evaluation.

items.q: Can hair fall be completely stopped?
items.a: Hair fall management focuses on identifying contributing factors and implementing appropriate treatment strategies. Outcomes vary among individuals.

items.q: Is laser hair reduction permanent?
items.a: Laser hair reduction provides long-term reduction of unwanted hair growth. Maintenance sessions may be recommended depending on individual factors.

items.q: Is laser hair reduction painful?
items.a: Most patients describe the procedure as mild and tolerable. Sensations vary depending on the treatment area and individual sensitivity.

items.q: How many laser hair reduction sessions are needed?
items.a: Multiple sessions are usually required because hair grows in different cycles. The exact number varies according to the treatment area and hair characteristics.

items.q: What should I do before laser hair reduction?
items.a: Patients are generally advised to avoid waxing or threading before treatment and follow specific pre-treatment instructions provided during consultation.

items.q: Can laser hair reduction be performed on the face?
items.a: Laser hair reduction may be performed on facial areas when clinically appropriate and after assessment.

items.q: Are laser treatments safe for Indian skin?
items.a: When performed after appropriate assessment and with suitable settings, laser treatments can be safely performed on Indian skin types.

items.q: Can laser treatments help pigmentation?
items.a: Selected laser treatments may help improve certain pigmentation concerns after clinical evaluation and determination of suitability.

items.q: Is there any downtime after laser treatments?
items.a: Many laser procedures involve minimal downtime, although temporary redness or sensitivity may occur depending on the treatment.

items.q: How should I care for my skin after laser treatment?
items.a: Post-treatment care instructions vary depending on the procedure and are provided after treatment to support recovery and results.

items.q: Do I need an appointment before visiting?
items.a: Appointments are recommended to minimize waiting time and ensure adequate consultation time.

items.q: Is WhatsApp appointment booking available?
items.a: Yes, appointments can be requested through WhatsApp or by phone.

items.q: What are the clinic timings?
items.a: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Please contact the clinic to confirm availability.

items.q: Where is the clinic located?
items.a: Aesthetic Dental and Skin Clinic is located near Sakhardhara and Azamshah Layout, Nagpur.
